scenarios.title: A stormy Monday
scenarios.blurb: A storm blows in at dawn for six hours, wind 25 m/s and rain 20 mm/h. Just after noon, as the crews catch up, an excavator finds a buried cable, a car hits the plant, and a fiber cable is cut.

scenarios.title: Construction season
scenarios.blurb: A dry, busy weekday: excavators find buried cable mid-morning, before lunch and mid-afternoon, and a car hits the plant in the evening rush.

scenarios.title: A heat wave
scenarios.blurb: From mid-morning the air runs 12 °C above normal for eight hours, the plant's amplifiers and cable with it, and mid-afternoon a fiber cable is cut.
